authorization: User requested work on obtaining the anchor after the completed supplied-anchor replacement probe. This contract defines one new finite implementation/execution; it does not rerun the old learner or historical fits.
question: Can bounded full-joint retained-history refinement obtain useful likelihood anchors from the fixed public entering mean, without a supplied fitted anchor or truth?
finish_line: One source-reviewed invocation, a finite accepted-anchor sequence or explicit unresolved stop, preserved trial/solve evidence, exact observation/prior ownership and closed resources. Report point improvement separately from inner convergence, nonlinear stationarity, posterior fidelity and target resources.
interpretation: This is a bounded retained-history nonlinear refinement driver. Inner direction solves do not read observations, but its C audits evaluate the complete prefix. No online, global-MAP, calibrated-interval or firmware claim follows.

input.format: little-endian <Qddd>: index, actual dt_s, current_A, voltage_V
input.scan: Before any model call, validate ordered finite prefix records, actual time and sequential charge extrema including initial zero. Bind full archive and prefix hashes before/after. This input scan is not a model pass.

unchanged_reference.chart: Original16D entering x=(logtau1..3,loggamma_plus,loggamma_minus,logQ,R0,R1..3,H,z0,v10..3,h0). Density relative to Lebesgue dx.
unchanged_reference.prior: One supported mixture of the same two public equal-weight Gaussian kernels; condition the mixture as a whole. Exact kernel cost/gradient/Hessian retained. Common support normalizer omitted only in cost differences.
unchanged_reference.support: Original entering box intersected with z0-Cmax/exp(logQ)>=0 and1-z0+Cmin/exp(logQ)>=0. Every represented candidate requires raw nonnegative slacks. No clipping or allowance admission.
unchanged_reference.initialization: PUBLIC_MEAN exactly, one start. If infeasible for the input prefix, stop; no substitute seed.
excluded_inference_inputs: truth files or prior reporting summaries

proposal.scaled_coordinates: D=diag(PUBLIC_SD), fixed public scales; x=a+D*u with current accepted anchor a. Numerical coordinates do not change the density base measure.
proposal.exact_gradient: g=gradient L(a)+gradient p(a), where p is the exact common Gaussian-mixture kernel penalty.
proposal.metric: B=full G(a)+diag(KERNEL_PRECISION). The mixture Hessian is P^-1-r0*r1*v*v^T <=P^-1. B is a full joint optimization metric and upper bound on prior curvature, not exact nonlinear Hessian or posterior precision.
proposal.subproblem: Minimize g^T*d+0.5*d^T*B*d subject to a+d in the unchanged support and |D^-1*d|_infinity<=1. Start at d=0.
proposal.metric_guard: Require finite exact symmetry and an unmodified Cholesky factorization of D*B*D. Stop on failure; no eigenvalue or covariance repair.
proposal.solver: Pinned scipy.optimize.minimize(method=trust-constr), analytic quadratic gradient/Hessian and exact SOC constraint Jacobian/Hessians, feasible box/SOC constraints, QRFactorization.
proposal.objective_scale: sqrt(max(1,||D*B*D||_infinity)), recomputed by this fixed formula at each accepted anchor. Report exact objective contrasts unscaled.
proposal.status: Retain raw optimizer and independent constrained-quadratic KKT status. A finite feasible unresolved return can propose a direction only after the independent decrease checks. Surrogate success is not nonlinear stationarity.
proposal.direction_admission: Require finite raw-feasible returned point within the declared step box, resolved negative g.dot(d), and resolved positive quadratic-model decrease under saved computed-product arithmetic allowances. No admissible direction stops unresolved; no fallback seed.

trial_policy.construction: At alpha=1 use the exact returned point. Otherwise use a+alpha*(b-a) in the fixed chart. Check raw support again before every C call. The exact support is convex, but floating-point feasibility is independently checked.
trial_policy.acceptance: Let s=-fsum(g_i*d_i)>A_dot. Accept only deltaF-A_cost > c1*alpha*(s+A_dot)+A_combine. deltaF compares the actual C nonlinear likelihood and exact same prior kernel at the current/trial points. A_cost is the existing computed-summand/four-term comparison allowance; A_dot and A_combine account for the directional product sum and final comparison arithmetic.
trial_policy.arithmetic_scope: Computed summand/product resolution only, not a global libm/derivative/nonlinear model error certificate. Save operation counts, absolute sums and all comparison terms. No voltage-error threshold or truth-derived gate.
trial_policy.knob_rationale: The one-public-SD step box, quarter-slope sufficient-decrease rule, binary trial fractions and iteration/call limits are fixed dimensionless optimizer/work choices. They do not define uncertainty, noise or physical accuracy thresholds, and are not tuned on the canonical result.
trial_policy.failure: An ambiguous or insufficient decrease is rejected. First accepted trial advances the anchor; all8 unsuccessful fractions stop unresolved. Invalid raw-feasibility trials are recorded without a model call. Numerical/model/resource failure stops the invocation without retry.

ownership.accept: Atomically install accepted point, its exact nonlinear audit/full g/G, prior value and endpoint state/transport. Increment generation once, archive old block. Reuse that audit as the next anchor without another model pass.
ownership.reject: Retain current point/block/prior/generation; rejected audits remain diagnostics, not likelihood factors.

accounting.reservations: Exclusive durable/fsynced pass and proposal reservations include counter before/after transitions and source/input/vector identities before child launch. Reservation consumes the slot even if execution remains incomplete.
accounting.captures: Keep raw_probe.json and probe.stderr names unchanged; no rename aliases. Share exact role paths/manifest schema between runner and reporter.
accounting.partial_failure: Preserve raw stdout/stderr, wait4 resources and any reported partial model/optimizer counts. A missing completion means unknown progress with a conservative reserved upper bound, never assumed zero work.
accounting.resources: Subtract elapsed global CPU/wall before every launch. CPU RLIMIT is rounded to integer seconds; RSS is checked at wait4. Breaches fail closure and stop further calls. Outer whole-process wait4 includes waited descendants; peak RSS is high-water, not summed simultaneous process memory.
accounting.output_closure: Include inner/outer receipts in the final byte total. Any failed outer closure vetoes success and scoring. Bounded failure-only emergency closure may preserve an over-cap failure but never claim compliance.
accounting.budget_outcome: Ordinary pass/round budget exhaustion with valid closed accounting is a completed finite unresolved outcome. Numerical/input/resource failure is failed. Neither means convergence.
accounting.prior_calls: Cache accepted exact prior cost/gradient/Hessian. One external exact-prior evaluation per completed model point at most, including the initial point. Proposal workers receive that saved prior payload; they do not call the mixture again. Any fabricated qualification calls are reported separately.

reporting.reference_use: Read the immutable prior summary only after the new inference closes; compare to its feasible matched-prior reference and reuse its already-verified endpoint truth record. It is not a global optimum. No raw truth file or historical fit is reopened.
point_metrics: initial/final nonlinear likelihood and common-prior cost
inner KKT statuses and saved nonlinear gradient
reporting.memory: Keep C fixed workspace10680B, compiler main frame11072B (contains workspace), external prefix8064000B and actual host RSS distinct. No complete10KiB target claim.

qualification_scope: Reuse prior/model source qualification. Add small dense coupled quadratic and active-support proposal fixtures, exact full-step/feasible-chord checks and stub lifecycle cases for reject/accept, no acceptance, cache reuse, durable call reservation, partial failure and cumulative caps. Freeze source and independent review before canonical inference; no canonical warm-up.
